review.notes: incremental re-review of 37 changed lines since 75b67e0: the one added target (AA.3.4 Arithmetic lattices in a real Lie group, README 3396-3431). Gate OK on my own run; movable depcheck 205 roadmaps, 1673 edges, 0 problems; lake env lean exit 0 with exactly 20 sorry warnings; one-tactic probe closes none of the 20 theorems and #check prints all 62 types (Lean file byte-identical to the previous head). Of the seeded sample only 3.4 falls in the change: Milne pp. 33-35 (Prop 3.2, definition p. 34, Prop 3.6) and Borel section 8 pp. 26-30 (Prop 8.12) read at their cache lines. R01 (P1): the definition and the converse of its variant use Whitney's finiteness of components of H(R) (owned by ArithmeticLocallySymmetricSpaces ALS.F.1, merge-order line 62, later than this roadmap at 31), Cartan's connectedness of real points of a simply connected group, and the isogeny-image theorem, none a target here, a permitted supplier section or a pinned declaration. R02 (P3): the SO_0(n,1) Check is false at n = 1 (SO(f) is a torus; no semisimple H surjects onto R_{>0}) and the definition lacks the negative control that it forces G^0 semisimple. R03, R04 (P3): the previous review's two P3 notes (Weyl-orbit locator Borel 5.5; 'changes both sides' wording) are unrepaired and re-raised. Adversarial table: 9 new rows with computed values for the added target, 30 rows carried from r10. Source issue: Milne p. 34 misprint Hol(D)^+ for H.
